_comment: Single source of truth for pre-flight quality thresholds shared between the Python server (app/preflight/quality_gate.py) and the TypeScript client (web/app/[sport]/page.tsx). Update both sides when changing any value.

_provenance.visibility_core: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker documentation: 0.5 is the lower bound of the confident detection band (2024).
_provenance.in_frame_ratio: 80% tolerates brief occlusions (arm swings out of frame during a curl top) while rejecting clips where the subject is persistently cut off.
_provenance.fps_floor: Nyquist argument: 25 fps / (1 / 0.6 s inter-rep minimum) = 15x oversampling ratio; tolerates 17% VFR jitter below the 30 fps target.
